inputs.text: It sounds like a familiar pattern: illegal mining continues, a company that KTR says belongs to Minister Ponguletti Srinivas Reddy is implicated, and the Congress government is accused of looking the other way. When powerful interests may benefit, that kind of inaction is hard to dismiss as ordinary oversight. The accusation may be only a fragment, but the rush to manage the story instead of confronting it is what makes the whole setup look protected.
